workshop: L4D2 2980835519 RE4 Remake Primal Knife (CS:S knife slot)
name: PrimalKnife
note: The Schiesshund's execution knife (ClassKnives.csv), Leon's from the Resident Evil 4 remake. 26.6 cm: the handle along +Y, a guard at 7-9 cm, the blade to +Y with its sawback spine on -Z and its curved edge on +Z, so tip [0,1,0] and up [0,0,-1]. The origin is the middle of the handle. Markers: Tip, Edge (mid-blade), Pommel.
